_: Per-suite end-to-end durations, harvested from ONE real CI run. WHAT THIS IS: the input to the shard assignment in .github/workflows/ci.yml, so that assignment is derived from data rather than from an impression. Consumed only by check:e2e-roster's PRINTED summary. WHAT THIS IS NOT: a budget, a bar, or anything any gate asserts against. No test compares a wall-clock time to a number in this file, and none may: docs/specs/ci-sharding/feature-spec.md 1.4 forbids a wall-clock assertion anywhere in this epic, because five samples of the same job span 40-47 minutes and the slowest measured altered no test at all. These are ratios that happen to carry units. STALENESS: the run id and date below are printed beside every projection, so a reader sees the projection's age at the same time as the projection. They will drift as suites are added and that is expected; re-harvest rather than trusting them.
residualCheck: The 44 web durations sum to 2049 s, matching docs/TECH_DEBT.md #301's independently-recorded 2,049 s exactly - residual 0 s. That is the sanity check implementation-plan.md Task 0.1 requires: a non-zero residual would mean steps were missed and the table does not add up.
keyedBy: The package.json SCRIPT NAME, not the CI step's title and not a prose suite label. A title is prose; the script is the key check:e2e-roster derives its own roster from, so the two cannot drift apart. Verified as an exact set equality in both directions against apps/web/package.json (44) and apps/api/package.json (2) on 2026-09-11.
